name: useKeyAgreement
summary: ECDH session key derivation with a private key generated in the Android Keystore; the achieved security level is read from KeyInfo.
plain: Generates an EC keypair in the Android Keystore (StrongBox when requested and declared by the device) and derives a shared secret via ECDH. The private key stays in the Keystore. The level the key really got (StrongBox, trusted environment, software) is read back from KeyInfo and is null when it cannot be read.
description: Uses AndroidKeyStore and the Java Cryptography Architecture. Generates an EC keypair with PURPOSE_AGREE_KEY (the Keystore default curve) and derives an ECDH shared secret against an external peer public key. When preferStrongBox is true and the device declares android.hardware.strongbox_keystore, StrongBox is requested; the achieved level is read with KeyInfo.getSecurityLevel() (API 31+) and returned as securityLevel (STRONGBOX, TRUSTED_ENVIRONMENT, SOFTWARE, UNKNOWN_SECURE), or null with securityLevelReason when it cannot be read or generation failed.

returns.name: isStrongBoxSupported
returns.desc: Whether the device declares the android.hardware.strongbox_keystore feature.

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Latest error message if keypair generation or secret derivation failed.

returns.name: generateKeyPair
returns.desc: Generates an EC keypair in the Android Keystore with PURPOSE_AGREE_KEY; securityLevel is read from KeyInfo.

returns.name: deriveSharedSecret
returns.desc: Computes an ECDH shared secret using the Keystore private key and the peer's public key.

actions.name: generateKeyPair(alias, preferStrongBox)
actions.desc: Generates an EC keypair in the Android Keystore. Resolves with publicKeyBase64 and securityLevel (null when unreadable or when generation failed, with the reason in error).

actions.name: deriveSharedSecret(alias, peerPublicKeyBase64)
actions.desc: Derives a shared secret via ECDH with a peer's public key. Resolves with sharedSecretBase64 (null on failure, with the reason in error).

agentNote: securityLevel is what the platform reported for the generated key, not what was requested: a request for StrongBox on a device without the feature yields a different level or null. The private key is not exported by this API.
